support.title: Help & Support
support.description: Find answers to common questions about ANS or reach out to our engineering and community team.

whatIsPrompt.question: What are Prompts and Workflows on ANS?
whatIsPrompt.answer: A prompt is a structured instruction for an AI model, while an ANS Workflow chains fact extraction, visual generation, and template rendering into a reusable pipeline so you can ship complete projects in minutes.

whyPromptsMatter.question: Why use structured workflows and studio tools?
whyPromptsMatter.answer:
Compared with ad-hoc chat prompts, structured studio workflows matter when:

• Building 3D personal websites, open-source README showcases, or AIGC storyboards with consistent layout quality
• Editing and previewing for free before confirming any paid model execution
• Exporting HTML and JSON drafts that you can tweak anytime without re-running paid tasks

whatIsPromptschat.question: What is ANS?
whatIsPromptschat.answer: ANS (AI Never Stops) is an AI co-creation and project delivery platform for students, builders, and developers—combining Project Explore, Workflow & Studio Market, VibeHub design knowledge, and Hackathon team compute grants.

howToUse.question: How do I start building my first project on ANS?
howToUse.answer: Browse Projects or the Market to pick a studio or workflow (such as the 3D Personal Website Studio), launch the interactive editor to customize text and camera stops for free, and export your HTML or sign in to save versions.

license.question: Who owns the resumes, websites, and workflows I create on ANS?
license.answer: You retain 100% ownership and copyright over your personal resumes, 3D personal websites, private workflows, and competition submissions. Public marketplace listings and open-source breakdowns follow the license specified by their authors—your personal work is never forced into the public domain.

selfHost.question: How do team competitions and compute grants work?
selfHost.answer: Visit Teams or Competitions to create or join a team. Once an event's compute window opens, the team owner can claim shared team compute credits for private workflow runs.

verification.question: How can I publish my own project to the Showcase or Explore?
verification.answer: Sign in and click '+ Submit Project' or visit the Community Hub to share your project highlights, live preview URL, or GitHub repository and earn community XP.

aiCredits.question: How do ANS compute points and refunds work?
aiCredits.answer: Manual text edits, preset switching, live previews, and HTML/JSON exports are completely free (0 points). Compute points are only reserved after you explicitly confirm a paid AI task (such as 3D avatar generation, four-view preparation, or AI copywriting) and are automatically refunded if an upstream task fails.

attribution.question: What if I encounter a page issue, verification block, or attribution error?
attribution.answer: Check live service health on /status first, or use the form below to open an issue on our GitHub repository so the engineering team can investigate promptly.
